headline_outcome: Own Your Space. End the Cycle.
primary_text: "Our lease is up in 12 months and the landlord wants a 30% increase or we're out." This is the reality for hundreds of small businesses in Melbourne's west right now. You have zero leverage, zero certainty, and zero equity. It's time to break the cycle. Our off-the-plan warehouses in Truganina give you a 12–18 month runway to transition from renting to owning. Lock in the price now, plan your move, and never face a lease renewal again. Minutes from Princes Freeway and West Gate Tunnel. Purpose-built for owner-occupiers.
description: Never face a 30% rent increase again — own your Truganina warehouse outright.
